title: Existence of normalized slice tensor, Hom and Koszul comparisons
statement: For a site J small relative to the module universe, a commutative ring sheaf A, and U in the site, fix the independent-universe derived internal Homs and exact slice restriction. Fix closed tensor-Hom structures S and S_U together with their canonical K-flat tensor and uncurrying models [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. There exists comparison data d as in [def-sfb-ringed-slice-comparison-model] satisfying all four representative normalizations: pure-tensor restriction with its localization square, local Hom-family restriction with its fixed K-injective augmentation square, and the source and slice Koszul formulas. No evaluation or transposition compatibility is asserted here.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 08JB, 08FI and 03EL; the tensor and Hom comparison constructions, and the signed total-complex exchange.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat complex $P$ representing $L$, a K-injective complex $I$ representing $M$, and put $A=\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,I)$. Then $A$ represents $H(L,M)$ by the derived-Hom definition. Choose also a flat-term K-flat resolution $q:Q\to A$. These resolutions exist for arbitrary unbounded complexes by the two cited existence statements. Apply the K-flat pullback clause to the localization morphism with identity ring map: $rP,rQ$ are K-flat with flat terms. The restriction theorem makes $rI$ K-injective. Exact restriction represents $r$ on these complexes and takes $q$ to a quasi-isomorphism. Thus the tensor of the two K-flat models $Q,P$, and the Hom models $A$ and $\mathcal Hom^\bullet(rP,rI)$, compute all objects in the evaluation square.

For a test object $V\to U$, relocalization identifies $(\mathcal C/U)/(V/U)$ with $\mathcal C/V$, with the same covering families. A degree-$n$ local section of $rA$ is therefore exactly the family of local module maps $P^p|_V\to I^{p+n}|_V$ defining a degree-$n$ section of $\mathcal Hom^\bullet(rP,rI)$. This identification commutes with every restriction map and with $d(h)=d_Ih-(-1)^n h d_P$, since both sides have identical components. It is precisely the normalized comparison $\eta$ in the statement and the restriction isomorphism of the cited internal-Hom theorem. On the tensor side, $\rho$ is well defined and natural. For K-flat flat-term $P,R$, [lem-sfb-localized-site-tensor-restriction] gives summand isomorphisms sending $x\otimes y$ to $x\otimes y$, natural in both factors. Restriction commutes with the direct sums of $\operatorname{Tot}$: a sheaf sum is the sheafified presheaf sum (sheafification is a left adjoint), presheaf sums restrict sectionwise, and slice restriction commutes with sheafification [lem-cbc-sieve-slice-sheafification, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. The summand maps preserve $d\otimes1$ and $(-1)^p1\otimes d$ by naturality and additivity, so they form a chain isomorphism natural in chain maps and homotopies. The descent statement extends it uniquely to a natural isomorphism on $D(\mathcal O)\times D(\mathcal O)$; this is the 07A4 comparison.

Construct the source and slice signed total-tensor exchanges. In bidegree (p,q) use (-1)^(pq) times exchange, whose inverse is the same exchange with reversed degrees. The differential identities show these are chain maps. Descend their natural isomorphisms along the K-flat presentations and conjugate with T and T_U. The representative squares hold by construction, giving both Koszul normalization predicates. Together with the preceding tensor and Hom constructions this gives the normalized comparison datum.

theorem ringedSlice_normalizedComparisons
    (U : C) [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{max c v u} ((sheafCompose (J.over U) (forget₂
      CommRingCat.{max c v u} RingCat.{max c v u})).obj (A.over U)))]
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A))
    (T : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, c, v, w} J A S)
    (SU : CoefficientClosedStructure
      (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U)))
    (TU : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, max c v, v, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U) SU) :
    Nonempty {d : RingedSliceEvaluationComparisons (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A)
      (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U))
      (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U) S SU (RingedSliceFlatRestriction.{c, v,
      u} J A U) // RingedSliceEvaluationNormalized.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U S T SU TU d}
